Class HostUIBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.HostUIBuilder
public final class HostUIBuilder extends Object
Connects drawing, input, resizing, and cleanup functions to one vanilla Minecraft screen.

Use this when a GuiScreen needs additional behavior while it is displayed in a desktop window. The result is the HostUI adapter that Offscreen calls for that screen. The builder does not open a window or install a separate renderer. Create a new builder and backing screen for each open window, and use them on the client thread.
